name: langgraph-copilotkit-react-monorepo
description: Polyglot monorepo: React product catalog + LangGraph multi-agent + CopilotKit runtime (A2UI) + MCP tool server

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n mcp,agent,web -c magenta,cyan,green "pnpm dev:mcp" "pnpm dev:agent" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.dev:agent: uv run --project apps/agent langgraph dev --host localhost --port 2024 --no-browser
scripts.setup:python: uv sync --project apps/mcp && uv sync --project apps/agent
